title: Codex v Claude, observation
author: arangar
selftext:
I been using Claude to code a unity project, where I use Opus as an architect driving Sonos for coding via MCP.

Never hitting the daily limit and token burn feels low.

  
I got a free month of Codex, Spun up a Astra architect driving Sol coding - hitting 5h limit in 30 mins on a Unity project via MCP. Granted, it is a different Unity project (but much smaller).

  
Is this concistent with others experiences? I'm pretty sure I'm done with Codex once the free month runs out.

comments.author: redditscraperbot2
comments.body: Yes claude is widely regarded to be far more generous with its usage limit that OAI. *At the current moment*

replies.author: arangar
replies.body: thanks, yeah - It was free so can't complain; Just surprised at what felt like a massive difference

replies.author: Fuzzzy420
replies.body:
Really? 
Last week my codex budget got reset 3 times for free. In the first week using Claude I would agree, but now I just use it all up in a day or two (pro abo).
I haven't managed to reach my codex limit this week thanks to the resets.

comments.author: Quantizeverything
comments.body: Not too long ago it was the opposite.

comments.author: Horror-Detective4138
comments.body: I have the $200 plan with codex, so with all these resets I've been running multiple instances of astra with no issues

replies.author: arangar
replies.body:
Yeah, I got the $20 for free, assume my 5h window is tiny compared to yours - what model are you running for what?

I'd never go 200 plan based on this experience though comparing it side by side with Claude

replies.author: Horror-Detective4138
replies.body: Yeah I can't possibly compare, I've never used Claude. I don't have a 5 hour window, it's 100% able to be used at all times. I'm running astra, typically an hour and a half of usage is 1% of my total for the week.

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: Well that's what money gets you. I'm not at the $200 a month budget yet.

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: I also got the $20 for free and made sure to drain it every day.

comments.author: Upper-Philosophy2376
comments.body: If I use Sol I barely run out, if I use Astra it runs out really fast. Opus does ok to not run out. My best combo so far is to have opus delegate JR dev tasks to Sol via codex.

replies.author: arangar
replies.body:
might try and swap the architect to Sol next window, see how it does

thanks

comments.author: SeasawPhilosopher
comments.body: Claude is way better for game dev tasks than codex.
